title: 붕어입 만들기
instruction: 볼을 살짝 안으로 당기고 입술을 둥글게 모으세요.
caption: 볼을 살짝 당겨 붕어입 모양을 만드세요.
motion_prompt: Draw both cheeks slightly inward and form a small rounded fish-mouth shape with the lips, hold briefly, then relax completely.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: gentle fish mouth: BOTH cheeks drawn slightly inward with subtle visible hollows, rounded closed lips protruded forward; comfortable relaxed eyes
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for lip_11_fish_mouth. EXACTLY 1 columns and 2 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:18. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Tile poses: TILE 1: relaxed neutral closed lips. TILE 2: gentle fish mouth: BOTH cheeks drawn slightly inward with subtle visible hollows, rounded closed lips protruded forward; comfortable relaxed eyes. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
